notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only (own tab), Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront (Sites-polspotten-b2c-Site, en_NL); all reads were same-origin fetch() from the loaded page context. robots.txt HTTP 200, single generic 'User-agent: *' group, no Claude/anthropic/ClaudeBot mention and no full-site Disallow -> cleared to extract. TREE (union of three sources per the mandatory cross-check): the rendered mega-menu, the /en/furniture/ category page's own link block, and the category sitemap (/en/sitemap_index.xml -> /en/sitemap_3-category.xml, 535 locs, 107 canonical /en/ paths after stripping be/lu locale duplicates). All three agree on exactly the same 8 furniture children: Stools, Chairs, Lounge, Coffee Tables, Side Tables, Tables, Cabinets, Pillars. The nav did NOT under-report here. THIRD LEVEL EXCLUDED: the sitemap exposes 5 deeper furniture nodes - chairs/happy-days, chairs/henry, stools/dot, stools/tip-tap, stools/zig-zag. These are single-design product-family pages, not product-type subcategories: verified stools/zig-zag (title 'Zig Zag', breadcrumb stops at Home > Furniture > Stools, i.e. it adds no taxonomy level). The identical pattern runs site-wide outside furniture (home-decor/vases/formy, /vases/steps, /candle-holders/twiggy, /candle-holders/drip), and the prior Home-Decor pass likewise did not split vases or candle holders into these. Excluded per NEVER-EXTRACT (product collections). Also excluded: colour/material refinement URLs under each node (chairs/beige, chairs/black, chairs/textile, chairs/synthetic-material, lounge/blue1 etc - filter pages), 'stools-edit' (curated edit landing page), design-collabs designer pages, gifting/sale/new-collection curation, and the fabric-*/swatch-* upholstery swatch pages. QTY METHOD (Rule 1, rendered header): every node prints '<N> Results' in the header and 'Showing X of N results' in the footer, both present in the server-rendered HTML and agreeing exactly on all 8 nodes. No structured-data fallback was needed. SANITY CHECKS: (a) counts vary per node (75/25/19/8/17/5/1/4) - not a constant site-wide total; (b) parent /en/furniture/ reports 152 while the 8 children sum to 154, so the parent is NOT a sum and no child inherited a parent number - children recorded individually, parent emitted as a grouping row only; (c) bad-slug test per the known trap: /en/furniture/wardrobes-xyz123/, /sofas/, /beds/, /desks/ all return a soft-200 homepage/'Assortment' page carrying NO count at all, so this platform cannot hand back a plausible wrong number - and it confirms Pols Potten has no sofa, bed or desk category; (d) every recorded leaf was confirmed by title and/or breadcrumb matching the requested node (e.g. Tables breadcrumb 'Home > Furniture > Tables'; its <title> 'Dining Tables | POLSPOTTEN' is an SEO title only, so the node name 'Tables' was taken from the breadcrumb and mega-menu); (e) two independent reads of lounge/coffee-tables/tables/cabinets agreed exactly - no intra-session drift; (f) tile counting deliberately avoided - DOM tile counts are inflated by recommendation carousels (Cabinets showed 3 [data-pid] tiles for a real count of 1), consistent with the brief's warning. CLASSIFICATION: Lounge verified as genuine seating (Peggy Chair, Fizz Lounge Chair, Braided Outdoor Pouf - poufs filed by the site under furniture/seating, so included per the brief). Coffee Tables and Tables verified as real tables (Disc/Oval Marble Look Coffee Table, Zig Zag Coffee Table; Stilts Rectangular Dining Table, Glass Bar Table). Two nodes flagged: Cabinets (qty 1, sole product 'Bricks Book Stand' - a bookend, not a cabinet) and Pillars (4 'Marble Look Pillar' display plinths). Both emitted rather than dropped, since omission is unrecoverable at merge. No room-based navigation exists on this site (flat type-based taxonomy), and no furniture-typed node hides in the home-decor, lighting or tableware departments - the full canonical /en/ category list was scanned for furniture slugs and only the /en/furniture/ branch matched. No block, 403, CAPTCHA or rate-limit was encountered at any point.
